description: Search documented superhot and high-temperature geothermal wells worldwide (IDDP, Venelle-2, Kakkonda, Nesjavellir, The Geysers, Puna, Utah FORGE, Fervo, Mazama and more): max temperature, depth, lithology, what failed at temperature, root cause, lessons, induced seismicity, and a public source per well. Use it for drilling, completion, materials, site-comparison, or risk questions.

minTempC.description: Only wells at or above this max temperature (°C). 374 = supercritical.

query.description: Optional keywords: a well, country, operator, rock type, or failure mode (e.g. "cement", "seismicity").

name: search_wells
title: Search the Superhot Well Registry
